main_findings.seb_gap_identity: For the p-row boundary tp, sigma_t + pi_{t+1} = B_t - A_t - 1, where A_t and B_t are the adjacent primes bracketing tp.
main_findings.row_p_insufficiency: Row(p) only gives sigma_t + pi_{t+1} <= 2p-2, while SEB needs sigma_t + pi_{t+1} < q=p+g.
main_findings.gap_barrier: A direct uniform proof of SEB is close to proving G(p^2) <= q, a Legendre-scale prime-gap input not supplied by current unconditional tools.
main_findings.replacement_target: Use ASB(p,q), the arithmetic sampled endpoint barrier, instead of global SEB.

asb_definition.condition: for every relevant s with r_s>g, sigma_{t_s}<p-r_s or pi_{t_s+1}<r_s+g

next_obligations: Formalize ASB-Fail as a q-row empty-window contradiction pattern.
Exploit the drift residues r_s=(s-1)(q-p) mod p rather than all p-row boundaries.
Use CRT phase, local slope-cover capacity, adjacent-coprimality, and row/column duality to bound ASB-Fail coverage.
Keep SEB as a diagnostic sufficient condition, not as the unconditional minimal target.
